subject: T2: dispatcher consults ask-gate before request_guidance
description: Wire the consuming behavior so the dispatcher predicts from KB instead of defaulting to asking. (a) Establish the preference-note convention: record_decision calls capturing a user preference set category:"preference" (and the dispatcher/CLAUDE.md instructs capturing user decisions this way). (b) Update CLAUDE.md + the dispatcher path so that before calling request_guidance, the dispatcher consults the ask-gate (T1): if decision:'predict', apply the matched preference note silently and proceed; if decision:'ask', escalate via request_guidance as today. (c) Ensure the hard-override triggers (irreversible/outward-facing/high-impact) still always ask. Keep it surgical — this is instruction + thin wiring, not a rewrite of the guidance path.

summary: Gated request_guidance at the seam (enforced, predict-by-default). Extracted shared recall+gate+journal path to lib/ask-gate-recall.js (runAskGate); POST /ask-gate (routes/graph.js) now delegates to it (no behavior change). routes/session.js POST /guidance runs the gate FIRST: decision:predict auto-resolves from the matched category:"preference" note (predicted answer + provenance via annotateGuidance/resolveGuidance, NO pending-queue entry, NO loop pause, returns predicted:true); decision:ask falls through to the unchanged escalation. Hard-override (irreversible/outward/highImpact/scopeExpansion/repeatedFailure) always escalates; structured action-guidance (dup-cluster/follow-up) bypasses. lib/mcp-core.js request_guidance tool now documents last-resort/predict semantics + exposes the 5 override flags. CLAUDE.md: capture USER preferences as category:"preference" + a predict-by-default dispatcher rule. Files: lib/ask-gate-recall.js (new), routes/session.js, routes/graph.js, lib/mcp-core.js, CLAUDE.md, test/guidance-seam-gate.test.js (new). Tests: new seam test 16/16 PASS (predict auto-resolves w/o overlay.guidance[]; no-match escalates; hard-override flag+keyword escalates; journal seam-tagged). ask-gate.test.js 25/25, guidance-resolve 19/19, guidance-dedupe 3/3 PASS. test/endpoints.test.js fails on subagent-claim/mark-root mechanics — pre-existing, unrelated to this change (my diff touches only the guidance seam + ask-gate refactor). Committed to orch/attempt/0b5a907e-b58e-41cd-892b-4c0ca8d27099-2 (146b81b), tree clean, 1 commit ahead of base 971b28c.
